units.time: s from the start of the run, the origin of pre_movement; row 0 is time 0, before the first step; the last time can exceed t_max by less than dt
units.exit_time: s, end of the step in which the agent reached safety (an upper bound to within dt), not rounded
units.pre_movement_sampled: s, as sampled; the agent starts walking at the first step whose start is at or after it
units.link_flow: agents (heads) per step of dt that passed the link in the step (time - dt, time]; a rate in persons/s is value / dt
units.occupancy: agents (heads) in each node at time, not weighted by area factor; safe nodes are left out
